Dental Implants in Antalya, Turkey: FAQs

faq.q: What is a dental implant?
faq.a: A dental implant is a titanium post placed in the jawbone to act as an artificial tooth root. It bonds with the natural bone through osseointegration and forms a strong foundation for a crown, bridge or denture. At Akdeniz Dental Clinic in Antalya, implants are used to replace one, several or all missing teeth.

faq.q: What parts make up a dental implant?
faq.a: A dental implant system has four parts: the implant body, the abutment, the abutment securing screw and the crown. The implant body sits in the jawbone as the artificial root, the abutment connects it to the artificial tooth, the screw holds the abutment in place, and the crown is the visible tooth.

faq.q: When are dental implants needed?
faq.a: Dental implants are needed when one or more teeth are lost and you want to chew properly again. They can also help with speech problems caused by missing teeth, reduce the bone loss that follows tooth loss, and address aesthetic concerns. Your dentist in Antalya will check whether implants suit your case.

faq.q: What are dental implants made of?
faq.a: Most dental implants are made of titanium, which is strong, lightweight, corrosion-resistant and highly biocompatible. Other options include titanium alloys, titanium-zirconium (Roxolid), which is stronger than titanium, and white zirconium implants, which are often preferred for front teeth. The right material depends on your bone and the position of the implant.

faq.q: Can I pay for dental implants in Turkey monthly?
faq.a: Yes, you can explore monthly payments for dental implants at Akdeniz Dental through Ideal4Finance. Finance is subject to status and approval, and the terms depend on your circumstances. It is a good idea to get your treatment plan and cost estimate first, then decide whether finance suits you.

Hollywood Smile in Antalya, Turkey: FAQs

faq.q: What is a Hollywood smile?
faq.a: A Hollywood smile is a cosmetic dental treatment that combines techniques such as veneers, crowns, teeth whitening and orthodontics to create a bright, symmetrical, natural-looking smile. At Akdeniz Dental Clinic in Antalya, the plan also considers gum health, tooth alignment and bite, so the result is functional as well as attractive.

faq.q: How long does a Hollywood smile last?
faq.a: With proper care, the veneers and crowns used in a Hollywood smile usually last 10 to 15 years. Teeth whitening results may last from several months to a year, while orthodontic results are generally permanent. How long your smile lasts depends on oral hygiene, lifestyle and the materials used.

faq.q: Who is suitable for a Hollywood smile in Turkey?
faq.a: Most adults in good general and oral health are suitable candidates for a Hollywood smile. Suitability depends on your individual case, so a dental assessment always comes first. The team at Akdeniz Dental in Antalya will review your teeth and gums before recommending a treatment plan.

faq.q: Which veneers are used for a Hollywood smile?
faq.a: The main options are porcelain veneers, composite veneers, palatal veneers (onlays) and Lumineers. Porcelain veneers look the most natural and last 10 to 15 years, composite veneers are cheaper and done the same day but last 5 to 7 years, and very thin Lumineers can last up to 20 years.

faq.q: Is a Hollywood smile cheaper in Turkey than in the UK?
faq.a: Yes, Turkey is generally a more affordable option than the UK for a Hollywood smile, partly due to lower labour costs. The final price depends on the number of teeth, the materials and the complexity of your treatment. Contact Akdeniz Dental in Antalya for a personalised treatment plan.

faq.q: What are zirconium crowns?
faq.a: Zirconium crowns are metal-free dental crowns made with a zirconium oxide substructure, often layered with porcelain. They fully cover a natural tooth or a dental implant to strengthen it and improve its appearance. At Akdeniz Dental Clinic in Antalya, they are used for a durable, natural-looking white smile.

faq.q: How long does it take to get zirconium crowns in Antalya?
faq.a: Zirconium crowns are usually ready in an average of 1 to 5 days. At Akdeniz Dental in Antalya, the teeth are prepared and measured with CAD-CAM technology, temporary teeth are fitted until the crowns are ready, and the permanent crowns are then bonded in place.

faq.q: How much does a zirconium crown cost in Turkey?
faq.a: The cost of a zirconium crown in Turkey depends on the structure of the teeth to be crowned, the materials used and the number of teeth. Because suitability of the tooth structure is the most important factor, Akdeniz Dental in Antalya confirms the price in your personalised treatment plan.

faq.q: Do zirconium crowns cause grey or purple gums?
faq.a: No, zirconium crowns do not cause the purplish gum discolouration sometimes seen with metal-based crowns. Because they contain no metal, they also avoid the risk of metal allergy and give an aesthetic result close to the natural appearance of the tooth.

faq.q: How long do zirconium crowns last?
faq.a: With good oral hygiene and annual dental check-ups, zirconium crowns can be used for many years without problems. They are highly durable despite containing no metal. Keep up daily brushing and regular visits to your dentist in the UK or Ireland after treatment in Antalya.

faq.q: Is getting a zirconium crown painful?
faq.a: Local anaesthesia is applied before the teeth are prepared, so you should not feel pain during the procedure. The teeth are only reduced slightly, and temporary teeth are fitted until your permanent zirconium crowns are ready at Akdeniz Dental in Antalya.
